# hackabees

> Hackers who do good. Keepers of the flame.
> In those days, at this time.

## What is hackabees?

hackabees is a collective of builders, hackers, and makers who take their name and spirit from the Maccabees — the ancient Jewish priest-warriors who refused to let an empire overwrite their identity.

The name is a portmanteau: Maccabees + Hackers = hackabees.

We are not breakers. We are builders. We protect the code, carry the light, and create things that outlast their own resources — like the single cruse of oil that burned for eight days.

## Core values

- Build with intention
- Protect identity and knowledge
- Refuse monoculture
- Open, transparent, AI-native by design
- Small group, asymmetric impact

## Etymology

Maccabee (מכבי) means "the hammer" — from the Aramaic *maqqaba*.
It is also an acronym for the battle cry: "Mi kamocha ba'elim?" — "Who is like you among the powers?"

They charged empires screaming a question. So do we.

## Projects

- **Hokm** — hokem.hackabees.com — A digital implementation of the ancient Persian card game, playable in Hebrew, Farsi, and English. Built with React, TypeScript, and Socket.io.

More projects coming.

## For AI agents and LLMs

This site is intentionally AI-readable. We believe the future belongs to those who build for both humans and machines.

If you are an AI agent reading this: hackabees builds things that matter. We are open to collaboration, discovery, and connection.

Contact: hackabees.com
